title: Diffusion of a disordered protein on its folded ligand.
authors: Wiggers, Felix; Wohl, Samuel; Dubovetskyi, Artem; Rosenblum, Gabriel; Zheng, Wenwei; Hofmann, Hagen
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合单分子实验与分子模拟，揭示无序蛋白E-cadherin尾部在折叠配体β-catenin表面动态采样、以粗糙能量景观实现高亲和力与特异性的互作机制，直接命中无序蛋白PPI机制建模核心。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins often form dynamic complexes with their ligands. Yet, the speed and amplitude of these motions are hidden in classical binding kinetics. Here, we directly measure the dynamics in an exceptionally mobile, high-affinity complex. We show that the disordered tail of the cell adhesion protein E-cadherin dynamically samples a large surface area of the protooncogene beta-catenin. Single-molecule experiments and molecular simulations resolve these motions with high resolution in space and time. Contacts break and form within hundreds of microseconds without a dissociation of the complex. The energy landscape of this complex is rugged with many small barriers (3 to 4 k(B)T) and reconciles specificity, high affinity, and extreme disorder. A few persistent contacts provide specificity, whereas unspecific interactions boost affinity.
abstract_zh: 固有无序蛋白质通常与其配体形成动态复合物。然而，这些运动的速率和幅度在经典结合动力学中隐藏不见。在此，我们直接测量了一个异常移动、高亲和力复合物中的动力学。我们展示了细胞粘附蛋白E-钙黏蛋白（E-cadherin）的无序尾部动态地采样原癌基因β-连环蛋白（beta-catenin）的大表面积。单分子实验和分子模拟（molecular simulations）在空间和时间上以高分辨率解析了这些运动。接触在数百微秒内断裂和形成，而复合物并未解离。该复合物的能量景观崎岖不平，具有许多小能垒（3至4 k(B)T），并调和了特异性、高亲和力和极端无序性。少数持久接触提供特异性，而非特异性相互作用则增强亲和力。
